title: All 969 referenced organisations are publication-review-flagged, so P32.5's gate will withhold every organisation label and 100% of the spine's 42,488 organisation edges; 50 reviews in degree order would unlock 96.5%
evidence: Read-only spine query K05 (sig_read_public, 22:14:58Z, sql sha256 24ccb0cff9b5…): organization_type=unclassified, status=active, publication_review_required=true: n=969, referenced=969, in_claims=42,488, max_in_subjects=26,839; 4 other organisations (fr.police_municipale 2, us.le.municipal_police 2) are unflagged and unreferenced. K07 edge list (42,488 rows) → cumulative share by org degree: top 1 = 63.2%, top 21 = 94.5%, top 50 = 96.5%, top 100 = 97.3%. Code: organization_publication_decision withholds when publication_review_required and no ALLOW disposition (eligibility.py:201-206); claim_publication_decision withholds a claim whose object_entity is withheld (eligibility.py:225-227); the export applies entity_eligible_sql when the registry and organisations exist (spine_export.py:260). K02: publication_disposition is not readable by sig_read_public, so existing allow dispositions are unmeasured (assumed none, consistent with F-218: P32.5 not deployed, and F-282/G2 NEW-1: no tool to record allow). Inference: once P32.5 deploys, the network hub, every camera operator, buyer, seller, recipient and vendor node and all their edges disappear from the API and exports, so K2's graph and entity pages cannot ship without a review path. Extends F-218 and F-282 with the quantified blast radius and a degree-ordered review plan.

title: 'OpenStreetMap contributors (republished man_made=surveillance nodes)' is recorded as camera_operator of 26,839 cameras (63.2% of all organisation edges): a source modelled as an operator
evidence: K06 (22:15:26Z, sql sha256 fc4fb0e068d7…): top organisation by degree = 'OpenStreetMap contributors (republished man_made=surveillance nodes)', predicate camera_operator, subject kind traffic_camera, 26,839 claims over 26,839 subjects; comp.py over K07: the largest connected component (26,840 nodes) is this star; it is 63.2% of the 42,488 entity-ref organisation edges. Inference: the camera-registry target republishing OSM nodes sets a constant operator label naming the data source, so an operator view, a vendor/operator graph or an organisation page would present OSM contributors as running 26,839 cameras. The partner-identity module's own role gate says a registry publisher 'is recorded as text and mints nothing: a publisher is not an operator' (resolution/src/resolution/partner_identity.py:34-37), so this edge contradicts the stated rule. Distinct from the attribution findings F-107/F-134/F-373 (map credits) and from L1 NEW-6 (duplicate OSM republishes).
